speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Polycythemia Vera.

The combination of thrombocytosis, digital pain improving with cold (likely erythromelalgia), and fatigue in a 53-year-old male is highly suggestive of this myeloproliferative neoplasm. I request images of your blood smear to confirm the presence of leukoerythroblastosis or teardrop cells.
